name: Browser
summary: Reads and works in your own browser through Alexia's extension.

requires.why: Accept Alexia’s browser extension on loopback (127.0.0.1) only, with a token you paste once.
To keep its own settings and data in its own folder.

settings.label: Code for the browser extension
settings.hint: Paste this into Alexia’s browser extension once. Anyone with it can use your browser through Alexia, so keep it to yourself.

settings.label: Make a new code
settings.confirm: Make a new code? The extension stops working until you paste the new one into it.
